payload.root_cause: In `order_total` (pyshop/cart.py:71), the free-shipping decision is made against the pre-promo `subtotal` instead of the post-promo `discounted` subtotal: `shipping = Decimal("0.00") if subtotal >= FREE_SHIPPING_THRESHOLD or not cart.items else SHIPPING_FEE`. Because the promo discount is applied at line 70 to produce `discounted` but the threshold check at line 71 still uses `subtotal`, any cart whose raw subtotal is >= $50.00 but whose discounted subtotal falls below $50.00 incorrectly gets $0.00 shipping. For the reported case ($50.00 cart, SPRING10 => $45.00), `subtotal` (50.00) passes the check so shipping is 0.00 instead of the required 5.99. This violates the function docstring (lines 65-66) and the domain rules in README.md ('Free shipping when the *discounted* subtotal reaches $50.00').
